notes.title: Thank You
notes.content:
Dear Gamers:
Makai Agito has been out for almost a month. We want to extend a heartfelt thank you to everyone who has supported the game. We are just hobbyists working on nights and weekends and never expected Makai Agito to be received as well as it has. We're incredibly grateful.

Update:
As a token of our appreciation, we are looking for ways to give back. Due to heavy schedule conflicts, we don’t have any solid plans yet other than maintaining support.

Thank you for your support and understanding.
 
The Gumi Bytes Team
